user.title: Towngas (港华燃气)
user.description: Log in to {base_url}, then press F12 → Application → Local Storage and copy the value of the key 'token' (either the full JSON or just the access_token).

subs.title: Select gas accounts
subs.description: Choose the gas accounts to add as devices.

reauth_confirm.title: Token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The access token has expired. Log in to the portal again and paste the new token below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Towngas server: {detail}
error.invalid_auth: Token invalid or expired, log in again and paste a fresh token ({detail})
error.invalid_token_format: Could not parse the token, paste the full localStorage 'token' value
error.no_subscriptions: No gas account is bound to this login, bind one in the web portal first

init.title: Towngas options
init.description: Daily 23:30–00:30 (CST) is the Towngas system maintenance window. Data requests are skipped during this window and sensors keep their last reading; the token health check is not affected.

error.scan_out_of_range: Data refresh interval must be between 60 and 86400 seconds
error.token_out_of_range: Token refresh interval must be between 300 and 7140 seconds
